name: Cast two portraits in a 12-second neon hologram encounter
tagline: Two photos become a rain-lit walkway scene with a giant pink hologram
description: You Look Lonely is a single-template video generator that casts two people in a neon sci-fi scene. Upload two portraits. The 12-second clip shows one person standing on a rain-lit walkway looking up at the other, who appears as a giant pink hologram. Use only photos of people who agreed to it. Pricing is $5 per video as a one-time purchase, no subscription.
